description: Authoritative method ontology for AI collaboration experience package. Defines the method and collaboration_pattern axes used by #insight[method=...], /capture skill, decision points, and tag taxonomies.

method.description: The kind of decision being made or the collaborative thinking pattern applied to the content of the insight.

values.description: What problem are we solving? Clarifying goals, scope, and success criteria.
Choosing among tools, skills, frameworks, or implementation strategies.
Deciding what to include, defer, or cut under constraints.
Determining what context (files, conventions, memory) to provide to the AI.
Iterating on wording, structure, or examples to improve AI output.
Stating boundaries, non-goals, coding standards, or guardrails.
Recognizing drift and redirecting the plan or implementation.
Deciding when work is done, good enough, or should be stopped.

collaboration_pattern.description: The human-AI interaction mechanism through which the insight was produced, distinct from the decision content.

values.description: Insight emerged from structured grilling / AskUserQuestion alignment.
Insight emerged from entering plan mode and converging on an implementation plan.
Insight emerged from a throwaway prototype or quick validation spike.
Insight was explicitly captured via #insight or /capture during a session.
Insight emerged from code review, decision review, or retrospective inspection.
